I fixed the typo with a new migration and left `0007_add_customers.sql` as it was. This project has a rule that files in `migrations/` have already run in production and must never be edited. A change to 0007 wouldn't reach any database that has already applied it, so production would keep the misspelled column while new environments got the corrected one.

The new file, `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

I searched the codebase and nothing else uses `emial`, so no app code needed changing. I haven't run the migration.

Editing migrations in place until release works when they haven't shipped yet. Here they already have, so that approach doesn't apply.
